findings.evidenceJa: 震えがくるほど体は冷え切っている。
findings.governingReading: His body is chilled through enough to make him shiver.
findings.explanation: The English drops both the extreme degree and its visible physical consequence.

findings.highlight: my ripped uniform, and my own blood on the floor
findings.evidenceJa: 胸の破れた制服と、べったりと廊下に染みついた自分の血
findings.governingReading: The only certainties are the uniform torn at the chest and his own blood thickly soaked into the corridor.
findings.explanation: The English omits the tear location and reduces blood saturated into the corridor to blood merely on the floor.

findings.evidenceJa: こみ上げてくる物を堪えながら
findings.governingReading: He enters the classroom while holding back what is rising in his throat.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the nausea or vomit established by context with pain.

findings.evidenceJa: 手足に力が入らないまま
findings.governingReading: He has no strength in his arms and legs while cleaning.
findings.explanation: The English narrows systemic limb weakness to shaky or unsteady hands.

findings.highlight: the heat and nausea vanish from my body.
findings.evidenceJa: 体の熱も嘔吐感も下がっていく。
findings.governingReading: With several breaths, his body heat and nausea begin to subside.
findings.explanation: The English makes a gradual reduction into complete disappearance.

findings.highlight: ghosts with form, able to associate directly with people
findings.evidenceJa: 生きている人間に直接干渉できる幽霊
findings.governingReading: Ghosts with substance that can directly interfere with living humans.
findings.explanation: Associate describes social contact and loses the supernatural capacity to physically affect the living.

findings.highlight: holding my chest, I try to restrain myself.
findings.evidenceJa: 貫かれた胸を掻きむしって、つまらない自分を抑えつける。
findings.governingReading: He claws at his pierced chest to force his contemptible self under control.
findings.explanation: Holding removes the violent trauma response, and the object of restraint loses Shirou’s self-contempt.

findings.highlight: I just have to counter the intruder.
findings.evidenceJa: 来たヤツを叩き出すだけ。
findings.governingReading: For now he will simply beat the intruder back out of the house.
findings.explanation: Counter changes the concrete defensive objective into a generic tactical response.

findings.governingReading: He analyzes the object’s composition and materials.
findings.explanation: Basic quality neither expresses composition nor identifies material, weakening the technical stages of Strengthening.

findings.evidenceJa: 居間のただ中に立った。
findings.governingReading: He stands in the middle of the living room gripping the poster.
findings.explanation: The English removes his chosen position while waiting for the intruder.

findings.highlight: He let me hit him once, since I blocked him twice.
findings.evidenceJa: 二つ受けたらご褒美に打ち込んでこさせてやる
findings.governingReading: As a reward for receiving two attacks, the man allowed Shirou one opportunity to strike at him.
findings.explanation: The English falsely says Shirou hit the man, although the counter merely shifts the lance.

findings.governingReading: He attacks behind himself with no assurance that his prediction is right.
findings.explanation: Without a thought erases the deliberate prediction and recasts a calculated gamble as mindlessness.

findings.highlight: I hit a wall and come crashing down.
findings.evidenceJa: 壁にぶつかり、背中が折れる程の衝撃を受けて、ずるりと地面に落ちたのだ。
findings.governingReading: He hits the wall with force enough to break his back, then slides down to the ground.
findings.explanation: The English removes the impact’s stated severity and changes the sliding descent into a crash.

findings.evidenceJa: 一直線に突進してくる。
findings.governingReading: The man charges straight at him after readying the lance.
findings.explanation: Approaches removes both speed and direct attack trajectory.

findings.evidenceJa: 止まりそうな心臓に喝を入れる。
findings.governingReading: Sitting on the floor, Shirou exhorts his nearly stopping heart to keep going.
findings.explanation: The English removes the endangered heart and his forceful act of rallying it.

findings.governingReading: The spear-wielding man staggers from the girl’s heavy sword stroke.
findings.explanation: The English turns involuntary loss of footing into mental hesitation.

findings.evidenceJa: この小さな、華奢な体をした少女
findings.governingReading: This girl has a small, slender body.
findings.explanation: The English omits the delicacy of the build that informs Shirou’s first visual judgment.
